in_arabic.name: Nasya
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nasya هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Arabic, Nasya means 'Deliverer'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Nasah' which means 'to deliver'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Islamic culture.
